messages.author: c6ca7877bef91eef
messages.subject: Re: Slider in html
parts:
Note that if you are using the HTML UI, you need to explicitly include the slide js files in the head of the document.

<script type='text/javascript' src='shared/slider/js/jquery.slider.min.js'></script>

I am assuming that you already include jquery.js and shiny.js

You will also need to add a link to the css in the head of the document

<link rel="stylesheet" href="shared/slider/css/jquery.slider.min.css">

Hope this helps.

I also had some trouble getting sliders to work after trying the recommended approaches in this tread. What worked for me was -

1. to copy the entire shared folder from:
https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/tree/master/inst/www/shared

2. using ui.R, runApp(), then view page source, then copy all the html.

3. create a new html from output.

Thanks for the advice here.
